text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus was presented with a letter 
of appreciation from the student council 
for uncovering the culprit who trampled 
the flower bed, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Word has it that you solved the 
incident solely through the horseshoe 
tracks.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, it was not my achievement alone. It 
was only possible through the cooperation 
of Bamboo-san and Helios-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even so, discerning that it was the 
culprit's—or rather, Bamboo's footprint 
was truly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brilliance personified, truly. When it 
comes to horseshoes, perhaps there is none 
here who can rival you?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is an overstatement. My knowledge 
comes merely from self-study born out of 
an admiration for farriers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Admiration, is it... Indeed, true masters 
in the craft can identify an Uma Musume's 
physical growth and running habits from 
horseshoes alone.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... precisely as you say. You are 
remarkably knowledgeable, President...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Could it be that you, too, are 
acquainted with a farrier?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. There is someone who has looked 
after me for many years. My horseshoes are 
always custom-made by that person.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I knew it...! I have believed so for the 
longest time!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Speed, center of gravity, form... Your 
running style is flawless in every metric, 
President!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, standard off-the-shelf horseshoes 
could never withstand such exceptional 
levels of performance. Only horseshoes 
crafted specifically for the task could 
endure it...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that is why! I was certain! I always 
believed your horseshoes were fully 
custom-made...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: H-Hey now...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—And Air Groove-san! Forgive me for 
speaking out of turn, but you should 
switch to significantly heavier 
horseshoes...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
By doing so, the sharpness and control of 
your cornering would improve 
substantially!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Furthermore—Teio-san under the desk!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You, conversely, should reduce weight to 
minimize physical strain, which would 
allow you to fully capitalize on your 
natural potential!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~. ...Wait, how did you even 
know I was here?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Your passionate dedication to 
horseshoes has come through loud and 
clear. Perhaps it is time to calm 
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And so, I completely lost myself lecturing 
about horseshoes...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well, stuff like that happens. Don't 
sweat it too much.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, I have been this way since 
childhood... To lack self-control to such 
a degree... I truly despise this side of 
myself...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yikes~, she's really beating herself up. 
Maaan, what should we do here...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing. You heard all that, 
right? Mind giving her some words of 
encouragement?
choice_data_list: Are you confident in what you told them?
Could you pick out a horseshoe for me too?
Could you pick out a horseshoe for me?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing. You heard all that, 
right? Mind giving her some words of 
encouragement?
choice_data_list: Are you confident in what you told them?
Could you pick out a horseshoe for me too?
Could you pick out a horseshoe for me?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Without question. I would not have voiced 
it if I lacked confidence.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Then isn't that totally fine? You said it 
because you had the student council's best 
interests in mind, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it'd be different if they looked 
annoyed or anything, but that wasn't the 
case, was it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I do not believe they appeared displeased, 
however...
choice_data_list: Then there's no reason to feel down

Then there's no need to feel down, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is... true. I shall look at it that 
way.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ah... In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If it would not be a nuisance, I must 
introduce them to a specialty horseshoe 
shop I highly recommend...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, seeing how she is now... Guess your 
advice hit the spot, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, hold up, humans don't wear 
horseshoes, you know...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Horseshoes designed for human use... 
Come to think of it, I have never 
considered that concept.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Horseshoes tailored to the differences in 
human skeletal structure and muscular 
strength... No, first we must examine what 
fundamental benefits equipping horseshoes 
would even offer humans—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoopsie... Ikuno-san? Did your switch 
just get flipped again by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, empirical sample data is 
required. Trainer-san, please run. We must 
establish a baseline direction...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Man, I really didn't see this coming...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's for Ikuno's sake, and I'll lend 
a hand too. Just play along with her, 
okay?♪

Having it put that way, there was no 
refusing. And thus, I ended up 
accompanying Ikuno Dictus in her research 
into human horseshoes...
